competences.description: Attacks all enemies and inflicts Continuous Damage equal to the number of removed harmful effects from [Berserker's Armor (Passive)] for 2 turns.

Attacks all enemies 2 times. The first attack removes all beneficial effects granted on them, and the second attack inflicts Continuous Damage without a turn limit according to the number of harmful effects removed from [Berserker's Armor (Passive)]. The skill is guaranteed to activate if the boss' HP is at 30% or lower.

The boss' Attack Speed is very low, but the Attack Bar increases by 30% whenever an enemy's turn ends. The Attack Bar increasing amount decreases by 2% per harmful effect granted on the boss, and the boss is immune to Attack Bar decreasing effects. [Automatic Effect]
Removes all harmful effects if the boss starts the turn with harmful effects. Recovers its HP by 3% of its MAX HP for each removed harmful effect. [Automatic Effect]
